description: One Scale is a three-person student team from Dhaka, Bangladesh: Mostafa Tahmeed Foysal, Nahin Eftekhar and Prantik Biswas. We took on the MODIS and VIIRS harmonization challenge because fire and crop-burning records matter across South Asia, and the two satellite eras don’t agree. Our name is the idea behind the project: put 26 years of fire data on one scale, so the past can be compared with today.
